rows.grounds: compound describing a form that is both manifest and unmanifest
demonstrative pronoun referring to the form under discussion
past passive participle indicating what is recognized or declared
compound indicating possession of a manifest characteristic sign
indeclinable marking transition to a new topic
present passive verb introducing the description

items.question: How is the manifest-unmanifest form characterized by a manifest mark identified?
premises: A form is described as both manifest and unmanifest.
This form is recognized as possessing a manifest mark.
The description of this form is now being presented.
items.inference: The manifest-unmanifest form is identified as that which bears a manifest mark.
items.plain_english: This manifest-unmanifest form is known as having a manifest mark; now it is being described.
